evidence: Unengraved elongated oval red Yemeni-agate cabochon. The mount matches g7-17 part for part: tall faceted claws with double star-shaped claw tips at top and bottom; a pierced scroll gallery with heart-shaped openings at each side of the stone (v09 f009/f010 vs #1304); faceted blade (bud) shoulders made of an upper and a lower blade that end in a vertical beaded collar (f006/f013/f014/f025 vs #1301/#1305/#1306); a stepped band with a raised central ridge (f018-f024 vs #1302/#1303). Stone shape and proportions agree with #1304. This design appears on no other piece in any category. Compared photos #1300-#1306.
candidates_rejected: g3-37 (elongated red cabochon, but leaf-engraved and scroll-pierced shoulders); g3-36, g3-34, g7-23, g6-07, g6-08, g4-32 (other red cabochons in different mounts).

evidence: The engraving is the Fourteen Infallibles in 3 ruled nasta'liq lines: «الله محمد علي فاطمة / محمد علي محمد علي محمد علي / موسى جعفر حسين حسن ...». The same words sit in the same places, with the same line breaks, the same small stars, circles and dots in the field and the same double border line as #1259/#1260. Same mount: polished bezel with beaded rim on a diamond-knurled silver shank. Compared v31 f012/f016 with #1259 and #1260.
candidates_rejected: g3-22 (HS, also names the Fourteen Infallibles, but sits in a scalloped claw bezel on a fluted shank); g7-03, g7-05, g7-08, g7-13, g7-14 (same Jeddi knurled-shank family, but different inscriptions: Falaq, Nasr, Kafirun, knot design); g3-21 (Quran 65:2-3, diagonal grooves).

evidence: Same footage as v31; only the burned-in caption differs. Beaded bezel on a shank with plain diagonal flutes. No piece shows this composition. No 'Ring-1' folder exists in the catalog; only Ring-3 and Ring-4 exist (HS). The only Drive file named RING1 is the lead's screenshot P11_RING1.jpg, not a catalog photo.

evidence: Cushion-oval honey-grey agate with a dark band at one edge. Composition: a central panel of large stacked letters («...كفوا احد») on a cross-hatched ground with rosettes, framed by a border inscription that opens «بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم قل هو الله احد». Stepped double-beaded bezel; solid shank with broad vertical flutes and no openwork lugs. No catalog piece has this stone or this layout.

evidence: Large oval faceted green stone (emerald) whose table is ground into an octagonal panel engraved in nasta'liq «وهو العزيز» with flower fillers. With #13 turned 90 degrees, the layout matches v25 f005/f006: diamonds at upper left, the two loops of «هو» on the right, the tall alif-lam in the centre, the sweeping «عزيز» stroke on the left. Same mount: claw-tipped ribbed gallery bezel with rounded-top ribs, side scroll loops, open fan-ribbed shoulders with teardrop openings (f013/f018 vs #12). The metal looks warmer in the 2021 photos only because of the lighting. Files R013/R013-2 (#12, #13).
